== In-game ==

In-game, '''Chrono-Vectors'''<ref>https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/8413/chrono-vector-grimlock-saves-the-day</ref> are a type of [[Special Mission]]. The difference from these Missions and regular Spotlight Missions is that they have fewer rewards, and reward the Bot that was featured.

=== Forum description ===

{{quotes|Chrono-Vectors are mini-Quests designed to challenge and reward our Commanders. Each will be scattered across the many time-lines converging on New Quintessa, and will require your assistance to correct the past or stop it from splintering off.}}

=== List of Chrono-Vectors ===
* [[Grimlock Saves the Day]] (Featured Bot: [[Grimlock]])
* [[Generations]] (Featured Bots: [[Jetfire]] and [[Wheeljack]])
* [[Rebel Raptor]] (Featured Bots: [[Dinobot]])
[[Category:Special Missions]]

== In-universe ==

In-universe, '''Chrono-Vectors''' are devices invented by [[Wheeljack]] that could utilize [[Energon]] boosts to time-travel. In [[Grimlock Saves the Day|one specific case]], [[Grimlock]] took one of these untested devices and time-travelled to alter the outcome of the Great War. Wheeljack would later be revealed to possess a spare device.

=== Abilities ===
The only abilities Wheeljack's Chrono-Vectors so far have are teleportation and time-travel.

== References ==
<references/>
{{Special Missions}}
